scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --recursive --if-present lint && python scripts/run_uv.py run ruff check apps/api cad-service
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck && python scripts/run_uv.py run pyright apps/api/src cad-service/src
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --recursive --if-present test && python scripts/run_uv.py run pytest
scripts.format: prettier . --write && python scripts/run_uv.py run ruff format apps/api cad-service
scripts.format:check: prettier . --check && python scripts/run_uv.py run ruff format --check apps/api cad-service
